svg.title: Reverse Audit Launch Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-reverse-audit-launch-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Reverse Audit Launch Roadmap; subtitle: Run your own look-back, because the other side only hunts underpayments; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Engage a Fully Contingent Firm; deliverable: Signed engagement covering identification through check in hand; gate: Firm does 100 percent of the work on a 100 percent contingent basis (PM Business Advisors); week: Week 2; title: Set the Look-Back Window; deliverable: Refund scope at 3 years in most states, 4 in some, and 7 to 10 years where an old audit stays open; gate: Settle what is owed and build an audit trail for the entire audit period (Sales Tax Sisters); week: Week 3; title: Reconcile CAM and Customs Files; deliverable: Landlord general ledger, big-ticket invoices, and controllable-expense definitions; 7501 value matched to the commercial invoice and payments; gate: Before a CAPE upload, add 80 days to each liquidation date, confirm a US ACH account in ACE, and confirm no drawback on any entry line (Flexport); week: Week 4; title: Lock the Gains; deliverable: Pre-purchase taxability check routed from purchasing to the tax team (Cherry Bekaert); gate: Any FedEx CSA renegotiation goes in writing with an exact-dollar revenue ask (Route Consultant); caption: Sales tax, workers comp, customs, CAM, and FedEx contract operators run the same play: find the overpayments the other side's audit never looks for. SMP Consulting Group cites a $190,000 Kentucky workers comp recovery over three years.; assumptions note: Week slots sequence the reported steps; no week-by-week durations were reported. Reported clocks: 7 days to pick a MISO for the 1% early-accept bonus ($10,000 on $1,000,000), 4 to 6 months ahead for unique characteristics, and 4 to over 20 hours per CAM location (RE BackOffice).; note: Attributed to PM Business Advisors (ePf76grjr8U), Sales Tax Sisters (LibBgjGxja4), Flexport (xtorVFI9g4c), Commercial Real Estate Escalations Made Simple (CWHu33HRBVY), Cherry Bekaert (S7Qlojol4pE), Route Consultant (-AnzYDP3LQw, 39UxCZgtvHU), Greg Walker (sM254iPKhSo), and RE BackOffice (5wJlP07wwrM).
